summary: End-to-end testing of Unmute platform. Backend: 28 pytest tests pass after fixing one bug in /api/questions/{id}/answer that returned Mongo ObjectId. Frontend: landing, student auth+feed+ask+AI+mine+profile+badges, teacher auth+inbox+reply+heatmap all verified. Role guards and protected routes work correctly.

minor.issue: Response included Mongo _id (ObjectId) causing 500 serialization error. Fixed by popping _id from ans dict after insert.

issues: Subject filter uses native <select> dropdown instead of shadcn Select for visual consistency with the rest of the themed UI.
`suggest()` helper calls /ai/auto-answer with text: '' (empty). Currently unused (no button renders it) but dead/misleading code; should pass question body if surfaced.

action_items: Optional: replace native <select> in Feed subject filter with shadcn Select for UI consistency.
Optional: remove or fix the unused suggest() handler in TeacherInbox.jsx ReplyBox (currently posts empty text to /ai/auto-answer).

Observation: backend get_current_user prefers cookie over Bearer. Works for the React SPA (axios doesn't send cookies cross-origin by default), but consider flipping priority so explicit Authorization header wins.

rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/questions/{id}/answer returned 500. RCA: pymongo's insert_one mutates the input dict by attaching a BSON ObjectId as _id; the route then returned that dict via FastAPI's jsonable_encoder, which cannot serialize ObjectId -> 500. Fix: ans.pop('_id', None) immediately after insert_one before returning.
